Main: «Кресло офисное» / «Стол компьютерный». Worktree: the English spec «Mesh office chair, black, with armrest» / «Computer desk 1.2 m, white».

parseGoodsCases.realistic: A Chinese factory's bilingual PI: 产品描述 (spec) then 中文品名 / 英文品名 — the Chinese customs-name column every export declaration needs.

parseGoodsCases.realistic: «Наименование груза» is the logistics term (CMR / cargo manifest) a forwarder's Russian packing list uses; the material note sits in an «Описание» column.

pickGoodsCases.realistic: Chinese export invoices for the CIS print the description in three languages in one cell; the model is told to write Russian with the original in brackets and copies the cell's own Russian.
